clue.text: Footballer seizing attention is tiresome

explanation.surface: A player who hogs the limelight is tedious company.
explanation.definitionFit: Something wearing exhausts you, so it is tiresome; a straight synonym.

clue.text: Club taking on standard festival

parts.note: a wood is a golf club
stock means standard, as in stock answer

explanation.surface: A club takes on a standard music festival.
explanation.definitionFit: The 1969 New York State music festival, the classic event of its kind.

clue.text: Warn a swimmer finally coming into contact with net?

indicators.note: the final letter comes into the tennis word

parts.note: in tennis a let is a serve that touches the net

indicators.note: finally picks the last letter

explanation.surface: Telling a swimmer to watch out for a fishing net.
explanation.walkthrough: The question mark flags the tennis sense of 'net': a let is called when the ball clips the net.
explanation.definitionFit: To alert someone is to warn them of danger.

clue.text: Picked up nine letters in Roman alphabet, or one in Greek

indicators.note: picked up in a down clue means lifted, so read from bottom to top

parts.note: A to I spans nine letters of our alphabet

explanation.surface: A comparison of how many letters various alphabets contain.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Picked up' is not a sound indicator here: it reverses A TO I in a down entry.
explanation.definitionFit: The ninth letter of the Greek alphabet, so one of its letters.

clue.text: Freely mastering … a European language in my case

definitions.text: a European language in my case

indicators.note: letters treated freely move into a new order

explanation.surface: A scholar boasts of fluent command of a continental tongue.
explanation.definitionFit: A scholar specialising in German, so for them a European language is the speciality.

clue.text: First person in France to get to opulent old Biblical city

parts.note: je is French for I, the first person singular
opulent means rich

explanation.surface: A French narrator reaches a wealthy ancient city.
explanation.definitionFit: The Old Testament city whose walls fell to Joshua's trumpets.

clue.text: Judge sheep's wool ultimately the best example

parts.note: a ewe is a female sheep

indicators.note: ultimately picks the final letter

explanation.surface: At a show, a judge rates one sheep's fleece the finest.
explanation.definitionFit: A jewel is a prized specimen, as in the jewel in the crown.

clue.text: Rules, for me, must be broken with a sense of guilt

indicators.note: the words are broken up and reassembled

explanation.surface: A rule-breaker admits that, for them, rules exist to be broken, guiltily.
explanation.definitionFit: Feeling regret and contrition for wrongdoing.

clue.text: Like a song? Stick around bass in the end

indicators.note: the stick goes around everything else

parts.note: a cane is a walking stick

indicators.note: the letter for bass goes in the word for end

parts.note: a tail is the end of something
B is the musical abbreviation for bass

explanation.surface: A musical query: a stick placed around the bass at the finish.
explanation.definitionFit: A musical direction meaning in a singing, flowing style.

clue.text: Australia working with Spain to produce gas

parts.note: Oz is informal for Australia
on means operating, working
E is the vehicle code for Spain

explanation.surface: Australia teams up with Spain to make gas.
explanation.definitionFit: A form of oxygen with three atoms per molecule, a gas in the upper atmosphere.

clue.text: Public argument about start of his deposition

indicators.note: the public argument goes about, i.e. around, the letter taken from his

parts.note: overt means open, public
a row is a noisy argument

indicators.note: the start of a word is its first letter

explanation.surface: A very public quarrel over the opening of someone's legal testimony.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Deposition' looks like sworn evidence in court, but here it is removal from power.
explanation.definitionFit: Deposing a ruler is toppling him, the same as an overthrow.

clue.text: Fellow with sound fruit tree

parts.note: a fellow is a man
sound in the sense of in working order, as in 'all systems go'

explanation.surface: A man beside a healthy tree bearing fruit.
explanation.walkthrough: GO as an adjective means functioning properly, which is what 'sound' means here.
explanation.definitionFit: The tropical tree that bears the sweet orange-fleshed fruit of the same name.

clue.text: Place an absolute mess, we hear

indicators.note: what we hear is a spoken word, so the letters entered match it only in pronunciation

parts.note: something that looks a mess is said to be a sight

explanation.surface: Someone complains that a location is a complete shambles, apparently.
explanation.definitionFit: A location where something stands or happens; a direct synonym.

clue.text: A lot of odd material arranged according to specifications

indicators.note: these letters are arranged into a new order
a lot of the word odd, but not all of it, so its last letter goes

explanation.surface: A heap of strange fabric is sorted out to the required spec.
explanation.walkthrough: 'A lot of' trims ODD to OD; OD plus MATERIAL is rearranged.
explanation.definitionFit: Something made to fit particular requirements, as a suit cut to measure is.

clue.text: Minimum cut retains foreign articles in losing editorial contribution

indicators.note: the cut word retains, i.e. holds within it, the articles
cut means the final letter is lopped off

parts.note: least means minimum
der is German for the and les is French for the

explanation.surface: A newspaper trims its content, dropping foreign stories and its opinion column.
explanation.walkthrough: A newspaper's editorial is its leader, so losing it leaves one without a leader.
explanation.definitionFit: Without the head article, read literally as minus the leader column.

clue.text: Blokes taken aback in tucking into cooked food without dissent

indicators.note: the reversed blokes plus in are tucked into the scrambled food
cooked suggests the letters of food are worked over and rearranged
taken back means the word is read backwards

parts.note: blokes are men

explanation.surface: Startled men, tucking into a meal, all agree.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Cooked' yields OFOD; the phrase 'tucking into' looks like eating but is the container signal, with the food as the outer piece.
explanation.definitionFit: People in full agreement think alike, so they hold a shared view without disagreement.

clue.text: Put too much effort into agreement with a lot of extremely meagre content

indicators.note: content here is the stuff held inside the word for agreement

parts.note: OK signals agreement

indicators.note: a lot of the word, so its last letter is dropped

parts.note: very means extremely
thin means meagre

explanation.surface: Fussing over a deal whose substance is extremely thin.
explanation.walkthrough: 'content' is a noun meaning contents, not satisfied.
explanation.definitionFit: To analyse a matter excessively, spending more thought on it than needed.

clue.text: Certain girls hate drugs being distributed

indicators.note: letters distributed are spread around into a fresh order

explanation.surface: Some young women detest the circulation of narcotics.
explanation.definitionFit: Girls who are someone's female children; certain girls in relation to parents.

clue.text: Happen to go round Sweden

indicators.note: the word for go goes round the abbreviation

parts.note: to exit is to go out
S is the international vehicle code for Sweden

explanation.surface: Someone happens to travel around Sweden.
explanation.definitionFit: To be real or occur at all; loosely, for something to happen or be found.

clue.text: Nipple seized by nippers almost last to appreciate a close encounter

indicators.note: the nipple is seized, held inside, by the nippers
almost means not quite all, so the last letter goes

parts.note: teeth nip, so they are nippers
a teat is a nipple

indicators.note: the last letter of the following word

explanation.surface: A teething infant bites at feeding time; a tender moment indeed.
explanation.walkthrough: 'almost' trims TEETH to TEET, which holds TEAT; 'Nippers' looks like children but means teeth.
explanation.definitionFit: A private one-to-one conversation, literally head to head in French.

clue.text: Manipulate King and Knight and study sacrificing Rook

parts.note: K is the chess notation for king
N is the chess notation for knight

indicators.note: chess players sacrifice pieces, so the rook is given up from study

parts.note: to read a subject is to study it
R is the chess notation for rook

explanation.surface: A chess game in which pieces are manoeuvred and a rook given up.
explanation.definitionFit: To work dough or muscle with the hands, pressing and squeezing it.

clue.text: Copper limited by regulation coming in explosive and aggressive

indicators.note: the regulation, holding copper, comes into the explosive

parts.note: TNT is the explosive trinitrotoluene

indicators.note: copper is bounded on both sides by the regulation

parts.note: a rule is a regulation
Cu is the chemical symbol for copper

explanation.surface: A police officer, bound by rules, turns up both volatile and hostile.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Copper' looks like a policeman but gives the chemical symbol.
explanation.definitionFit: Truculent describes someone defiant and eager to fight, i.e. belligerent.

clue.text: Great with cooking meat, ultimately admitting no liquid

indicators.note: cooking means the preceding words are worked up into something new
ultimately points to the final letter

explanation.surface: A recipe: fine work with roasting meat that seals in juices.
explanation.walkthrough: 'cooking' rearranges GREAT WITH; the final T comes from 'meat'.
explanation.definitionFit: A seal so tight that no water can pass through it, i.e. impermeable.

clue.text: Woman brought up recently-born children

indicators.note: in a down clue brought up means read upwards

parts.note: new means recently born

explanation.surface: A woman raised newborn children.
explanation.walkthrough: 'brought up' looks like raising children; it reverses NEW.
explanation.definitionFit: An archaic or jocular word for a young woman or girl.

clue.text: A lot of money seized by two in rebellious tribe

indicators.note: the money is seized, held inside, by the Roman two

parts.note: II is two in Roman numerals

indicators.note: a lot of the word, so its last letter goes

parts.note: a cent is a unit of money

explanation.surface: Rebels seize a fortune with a couple of insiders.
explanation.walkthrough: The Iceni were the British tribe led by Boudicca in revolt against Rome.
explanation.definitionFit: Boudicca's tribe in East Anglia, which rose against Roman rule in AD 60.

clue.text: Just like me, overlooking millions in the continent

indicators.note: to overlook something is to leave it out

parts.note: just like me is 'as I am'
M is the abbreviation for million(s)

explanation.surface: Someone compares themselves to others on the same landmass.
explanation.definitionFit: The largest of the world's landmasses, stretching from the Urals to the Pacific.

clue.text: Felt dizzy, supported by one religious advisor

indicators.note: in a down clue the support goes underneath, so this word comes below

parts.note: one's head swam, i.e. felt dizzy
I is the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: Someone came over faint and was held up by a spiritual guide.
explanation.definitionFit: A Hindu teacher or holy man who gives spiritual guidance.

clue.text: Most prestigious part of flight — after one disembarks

indicators.note: to disembark is to get off, so the letter leaves the word

parts.note: a stair is one step of a flight of stairs
I is the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: An air passenger's moment: the best bit of a trip, once someone leaves.
explanation.walkthrough: 'flight' looks like air travel but means a staircase.
explanation.definitionFit: Star used as an adjective means leading or top, as in a star pupil.

clue.text: Rumour recalled injury (head cut)

explanation.walkthrough: 'head cut' removes L from LESION to give ESION, which 'recalled' turns round.
explanation.definitionFit: Noises are rumours or reports, as in making noises about something.

clue.text: Work out international group's worried about passage

clue.text: Japanese artist depicting fish around America

indicators.note: the fish goes around America

parts.note: the hoki is a New Zealand fish
USA is America

clue.text: What has half of sermon applied to sin?

definitions.text: What has half of sermon applied to sin?

indicators.note: half of the word sermon, its first three letters

parts.note: vice means sin

explanation.surface: A wry question about a church event: preaching tacked onto wrongdoing.
